let squares = side * side

let board =
    (1::squares) |> map(tile => tile % squares) |> collect_list()

blank() -> int => board.index_of(0)

neighbours(square: int) -> LIST[int] =>
    (let found = LIST[int]()
     let row = square / side
     let column = square % side

     if row > 0 then found.add(square - side) fi
     if row < side - 1 then found.add(square + side) fi
     if column > 0 then found.add(square - 1) fi
     if column < side - 1 then found.add(square + 1) fi

     found)

slide(square: int) is
    let empty = blank()

    board[empty] = board[square]
    board[square] = 0
si

        Std.write_line(line)
    od

    Std.write_line()
si

solved() -> bool =>
    (0..squares)
        |> all(square => board[square] == (square + 1) % squares)

// Shuffling by playing legal moves leaves the puzzle solvable,
// which half of all tile arrangements are not.
for _ in 0..12 do
    let choices = neighbours(blank())

    slide(choices[random.next(choices.count)])
od

Std.write_line("q gives up")
Std.write_line()

        break

    if wanted < 0 then
        Std.write_line("there is no such tile")
    elif !neighbours(blank()).contains(wanted) then
        Std.write_line("that tile is not next to the space")
